name: MEV bot 0xdd7c2987 callback trusts caller-supplied CREATE2 parameters
summary: The unverified bot's uniswapV3SwapCallback authenticated its caller as the CREATE2 address derived from a deployer, init-code hash and token path that the callback data itself supplied, and then pulled the owed amount from a payer also named in that data. The attacker CREATE2-deployed contracts matching its own deployer and init-code hash and called the callback with the bot operator as payer, transferring the operator's approved WETH, USDT and USDC to itself.
notes: Mechanism from the exploit trace, as the bot is unverified: each forged callback's data carried payer 0x0000000000e71526, deployer 0xe10b2cfa (the attacker's contract) and init-code hash 0x593b8329..., and the bot then called transferFrom(payer, caller, amount).
Victim is the bot operator 0x0000000000e71526, whose token approvals to the bot were spent. All 139 earlier callbacks into the bot came from the operator's own transactions (campaign.mjs).
